meta.title: Get Location From a Photo — Free GPS Extractor
meta.description: Find where a photo was taken: read GPS coordinates from photo EXIF data, see them on a map and export a GPX file. Free, runs in your browser.
meta.keywords: get location from photo, find where a photo was taken, photo GPS location, EXIF GPS viewer, photo geotag, extract GPS from photos, GPX export

h1: Get the Location From a Photo
intro: Find out where a photo was taken: read the GPS coordinates stored in its EXIF data, see every spot on a map and export them as a GPX file.
emptyExport: No photos with GPS data to export

howTo.title: How It Works
howTo.intro: This tool reads EXIF metadata from your photos to extract GPS coordinates. Most smartphones automatically embed location data in photos.

features.title: Supported formats:
features.body: JPEG, PNG, HEIC, and other image formats with EXIF data

features.title: What you'll get:
features.body: Interactive map showing photo locations, detailed GPS data, and GPX export for GPS devices

features.title: Note:
features.body: Only photos with GPS data will appear on the map. Screenshots and edited photos may not contain location data.

privacy.title: Privacy First
privacy.body: All photo processing happens entirely in your browser. Your photos and location data never leave your device and are not sent to any server.
